title: DR7 Gas Dryer
sub: Matte black, gas, 7.0 cu. ft., steam
lead: Speed Queen's most complete dryer, in matte black. Ten cycles behind a digital display, steam three ways, Pet Plus cycles, and a moisture sensor that stops the heat when the load is dry. It carries the longest warranty in the line: seven years, parts and labor.

features.name: Steam, three ways
features.line: Steam Boost works on wrinkles and static, Steam Refresh freshens what was worn once, and Steam Sanitize is there for the loads that need more.

features.name: Dries to the sensor, not the clock
features.line: A moisture sensor ends the cycle when the load is dry: Speed Queen's Over-dry Protection. A cool-down then brings the temperature down before the drum stops.

features.name: Pet Plus cycles
features.line: Cycles made for pet bedding and blankets, with one for removing pet hair.

features.name: Ten cycles, kept your way
features.line: Ten preset cycles and four temperatures. Favorite Cycles keeps the settings you use most, and the display counts down the time remaining.

features.name: Seven years, parts and labor
features.line: Speed Queen backs the DR7 with a 7-year warranty that covers parts and labor.

also: 22,500 BTU gas burner; converts to LP with Speed Queen's kit, sold separately
Extended Tumble, which keeps the load moving after the cycle ends
Up-front lint filter with a filter guard
